title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1569: Suppressing myriad races (3)

section.p: Fate Pseudo Emperor’s voice rang out with a sigh, “Su Yu, why must you do this? Things have not escalated to a point where you need to drag everyone down with you. By summoning an uncontrollable existance like this, the entire Myriad Realms might fall.”

Far away, the old turtle also said in shock, “Su Yu, stop the summon. You’re trying to die with everyone. This existance…has surpassed the level allowed in this world. Just look at how his appearance is triggering the laws. You…what are you doing?”
Su Yu was confused. What was the meaning of that? Everything seemed really complicated.

Tiangu’s expression was also changing repeatedly at the realization that Su Yu was really capable of summoning such an existance. He coldly said, “Su Yu, if you want to die together, remember that I’ve lived a far longer life than you! This is not a loss for me! At present, the Allheaven Battlefield is not yet capable of holding such an existance. If you really want to fight, wait. The thousand-year-limit will end soon. This backer of yours…might not really be unequalled.”
Su Yu’s confusion deepened. However, he did not show it. Smart as he was, he managed to catch some of the information in Tiangu’s words.
Thousand-year-limit.
Holding…yet capable of holding…

Over the years, the Allheaven Battlefield had been closing and opening itself to the various realms repeatedly, as though it was operating in accordance to a certain set of rules. And according to Tiangu, the Allheaven Battlefield was yet capable of holding an existance at Old Zhou’s level. If he attempted to emerge now, tribulation would descend from the laws.

When Su Yu challenged Tiangu to summon those truly ancient fossils out earlier, Tiangu had not done so. Was that because of…the tribulation as well? He might be confused, but he naturally had to act like he knew everything.

He sneered and said, “You will have your answer after giving it a try. And you think this isn’t a loss for you? Well, this isn’t a loss for me either. I killed so many Eternals as a mere Cloudbreach. I could even drag all these Daofuses to the afterlife with me. This feels great. If you really don’t fear death, I can summon this existance one more time. Do you want to try me?”
“After the third summon, everything will go out of control. At that time, let’s see if an existance not even the Martial King could fully suppress could kill all of you.”
Someone exclaimed in alarm, “Martial King?”

Su Yu grinned, “Are there no mention of this in the ancient records? Oh, right, this was a matter preceeding the building of the Luminous Domain Mansion. This existance was a supreme expert of that era. A human. An enemy of the Martial King. Ultimately, he was suppressed in the mansion. But now, the Martial King is no longer around while this supreme expert is still here. I’m very curious. Are the so-called Emperors of the current era capable of suppressing this existance?”
The hearts of the Daofuses thumped violently.
Su Yu’s bluff had succeeded.

It wasn’t that they were stupid enough to fall. But that was simply too terrifying to doubt. And Old Zhou had indeed demonstrated his might before their eyes. Such an existance was definitely stronger than them. Furthermore, Su Yu had already summoned this existance once in the mansion.

For some reason, Su Yu was the only person capable of establishing a connection with that existance. Su Yu would not make up a story with the Martial King in it for no reason. Thus, it was likely that he was telling the truth.

Some of the Daofuses looked at the Heavenly Overseer Marquis and old turtle. These two were among the oldest of the bunch. They should know something, right? With a frown, the Heavenly Overseer Marquis sank into thought. Suddenly, he thought of something and looked up at Su Yu with a drastic change in his expression.
As for the old turtle, he sank into contemplation. Some of these memories were so old they had grown indistinct.
Suppressed by Martial King…Suppressed by Martial King…

Meanwhile, Heavendoom was busy giving three immortal kings a beating as requested by Su Yu. Noticing that he was the only person still fighting, he shouted, “Su Yu, continue! Go on! Let us shatter the sky above us! Shatter the laws! Shatter the Myriad Realms! Hahahahaha! I can join in and release the Death Realm as well. Let us all fight until the Myriad Realms cease to exist! Let those old bastards have nothing other than corpses to pick after returning! I’m unsealing myself! Su Yu, I am unsealing myself to kill them!”

Heavendoom was serious about killing the three immortal kings. However, he needed to unseal himself to do that. Since Su Yu was going to end the world, he wouldn’t hesitate to unseal himself as well. Should he do it?

And thus, he roared with laughter as he transformed back into a stone statue. As cracks appeared on the surface of his body, he said, “Su Yu, go on! I know who you’re talking about! Who else could it be? Before the Human Emperor created the world, the Martial King’s strongest rival was someone called the Martial Emperor. Due to their similar titles, only one of them could remain. Hahahaha! So the Martial Emperor isn’t dead?”
The old turtle’s expression changed. The Heavenly Overseer Marquis was shaken. Far away, Bountiful Treasure exclaimed in shock, “That’s not possible, right? Isn’t he dead?”

“Hahaha! That’s definitely the case. Since he’s a human, and he was suppressed by the Martial King, who could be sure if he’s already dead? Hahaha! Good! Good! He’s still alive! Even better if he’s mad! Su Yu, I’m unsealing myself! After killing these three, let’s lure some old bastards out and shatter the Myriad Realms together!”
For some reason, Heavendoom seemed incredibly excited at the thought of ending the world. Even if he would die doing so, he didn’t seem to care one bit. Slowly, his stone skin faded away.

Meanwhile, Su Yu was losing his mind. No! Why was this guy doing this? He was only bluffing! Brother Heavendoom! Could Dearest Brother Heavendoom stop messing around? He was definitely not interested in dying with everyone else.
He was only bluffing to scare Tiangu and the others.
He was only scaring the others against doing anything rash.
Just then, the old turtle roared furiously, “Heavendoom! Stop! Damn it!”
He was furious. Was Su Yu really trying to die with everyone else?
Definitely not.
Nobody wanted this. For some reason, Heavendoom was the exception. He alone was mad enough to welcome that.
What a lunatic.
Tiangu was greatly shaken as well. After a short pause, he sent a voice transmission, “Su Yu! Just what do you want?”

He was worried that Su Yu would really fall for Heavendoom’s persuasion and release that existance. That would be disastrous. It was not yet time for such an existance to appear. The Myriad Realms were still incapable of holding such an existance. This could very well result in the destruction of numerous races.

Su Yu was relieved, but he did not show it. Instead, he sneered and said, “I don’t know. I don’t want to die either, but you’re forcing me. Since I must die, I’ll drag you all down with me. Of course, I am a reasonable person. I only want the divines, devils, immortals, dragons, nethers, celestial chasms, and Heavenly Hunt Pavilion to eliminate the sixteen races whose Invincibles had attacked me earlier. I will accept that as the payment to end things here. You have so many Daofuses so this should be an easy task. If you’re so useless you can’t even do this, all of you should just die.”
Eliminating sixteen races.
The expressions of the various Daofuses changed upon hearing that.
Far away, a certain expert who had lost his tri-life body paled. Even further away, an Invincible who had fled to his own realm also paled.
Eliminating sixteen races to end the battle today.

Su Yu asked coldly, “So? Are you worried that the minor races will turn against you because of that? Don’t worry. They are too useless to do anything significant. You saw how useless the sixteen Invincibles were. They didn’t even dare to do anything earlier when they were all around me. Fourteen of them are dead. Only two remain. It won’t be hard to eliminate their races.

“Are you afraid of reprisals? Or do you think that the idiots would still have the courage to fight me again in the future? Since they have already proven their disloyalty, just wipe them out. I, Su Yu, am not someone to be attacked lightly. There is no need for those who are disloyal to keep existing.”
Tiangu did not answer.
Fourteen of the Invincibles were dead. Two remained.

The expert who had lost his tri-life body wailed mournfully, “NO! You can’t do this! Lord Tiangu, the immortals can’t do this! We fought for you! I lost my tri-life body because of this! Everyone else is dead! You can’t do this to us after making use of us! How will the other races view you all after you do this?”
This couldn’t do. He couldn’t allow the immortals to even consider the matter. That could very well result in the elimination of his race.

Su Yu said, “I won’t force you. I’m a reasonable man. How about this? The humans can send fourteen Invincibles and eliminate all the Mountainseas and Sunmoons of the fourteen races. As for the remaining two races, Great Qin King and the others can kill them. Or the two can self-detonate to end the matter. If they agree, I will spare their races.”
The expert who had lost a tri-life body looked at Su Yu and pleaded, “Su Yu! Please! We are only minor races! We never wanted to participate in the battle! We were forced!”
“But someone must serve as the warning, right?”

Su Yu said, “Either you die or everyone would have the courage to attack me. Think over this. Any human Invincibles willing to play executioner for me this time? I reckon the various races won’t stop the humans from carrying out this task, right? It’s only some bugs. Kill them, end the battle, and we can all go back home.”

Great Zhou King looked around and said indifferently, “There is no need for fourteen Eternals. Great Yuan King, Heavenly Seal King, Xia Longwu, Zhu Tianfang…the four of you will do. Go and slaughter all their Mountainseas and Sunmoons. Take some treasures back while you’re at it.”

The eyes of the four Invincibles flickered with surprise, but they left without saying anything. A short while later, Great Yuan King charged into a minor realm with a rumble. In the blink of an eye, miserable wails rang out from that realm.
Moons started falling unendingly.
“No! Lord Immortal Emperor! Lord Divine Emperor! Please! We are your vassals!”
The Invincible without a tri-life body continued begging.
Nobody said anything.

Tiangu knew that this would deter the minor races from fighting for them in the future, but the humans were the executioners this time. The minor races would also be wary of fighting for the humans in the future. Thus, all of them would suffer from this loss of reputation.
The major races would be wary of making the move themselves, but since the humans were doing this themselves, so be it.

With his hands clasped behind him, Su Yu floated in the air and looked around with a genial smile. He looked at the Invincible without a tri-life body and gently said, “Just go back. Go back to your own realm. There, you could probably put up a better fight.”

The Invincible stared at Su Yu while crying tears of blood. He came from a frog-like race. As he panted heavily, he said helplessly, “If I were to self-detonate, would…everyone keep the promise and leave my race alone?”
Su Yu answered, “Of course.”
“What if I swore my loyalty—”
“Nope.” Su Yu rejected, “I don’t accept disloyal vassals. It’s too tiring to defend myself even from my presumed allies.”
“Su Yu…I regret it…I regret…becoming your enemy…”
A loud rumble resounded everywhere.
An Invincible had been forced to detonate himself by Su Yu with mere words.
Crimson clouds covered the sky.
Not a soul said anything.

As for the other Invincible, he looked down at his own realm with a bitter smile, “How ruthless. How cold. Humans, divines, immortals, and devils…Sure enough, the so-called Myriad Realms and myriad races have always been yours. We have always been…nothing. Nothing at all.”
He looked at Su Yu and asked, “Can I pass on some of my treasures and knowledge to my juniors?”
Su Yu answered nonchalantly, “Sure. I only want you to die. I don’t care about anything else. Your people are free to take revenge against me as well. I’ll always be here. They can come at any time.”
“We wouldn’t dare…”
With a bitter smile, the Invincible’s aura dropped drastically. He was most likely transmitting his cultivation to his juniors.
Before long, a loud rumble rang out from that minor realm.
More crimson clouds covered the sky.
The minor realm shook.
Just like that, the last of the sixteen Invincibles died to save his race.

Excluding the major races, the Invincibles of the various races watched on bitterly, including those from the five elemental race. When things grew dire, the minor races were always the ones to suffer. The major races could afford these heavy losses, but not the minor races. Without their Invincibles, these minor races would be completely helpless.
Su Yu smiled and said, “Well, since we’re done fighting, let’s all go back home. Lord Heavendoom, stop unsealing yourself. Three old bastards are not worth this price.”
Up in the sky, Heavendoom grumbled, “How boring. Kid, why are you so timid? You should go real crazy this time.”
Su Yu chucked, “What’s the rush? This is only the beginning of the great chaos. Look, sixteen top hundred races have dropped from the list today. I believe more will drop from the list soon.”
Then, Su Yu roared with laughter. Everyone had an illusion that he was the number one monster of the Myriad Realms. With mere words, he had essentially pushed sixteen races toward desruction.
Sure, not everyone in those races was dead. But without the protection of their Invincibles, how much longer could they last?

While laughing, Su Yu turned, flicked his sleeves, and returned to the ancient city. Floating above the ancient city, he cupped his fists in a refined manner and said, “Thank you, Seniors for coming out to play with me today. I lived. Your participation will be rewarded handsomely.”

The various experts vanished while sneering. The Iron Devourer Pseudo Emperor, the old turtle, and even the two furious furballs left as well. The battle was over. Su Yu’s trump card was too strong. It was unlikely that anything would happen before the thousand-year-limit ended.
Alone, he suppressed the myriad races.

The truth was a lot more complicated than that, but the result was undeniable. Su Yu’s feat of pushing sixteen races toward destruction and forcing two Invincibles to self-detonate had still alarmed the myriad races.

All the minor races were feeling deeply bitter. The minor races, including the so-called top hundred races, were nothing but bugs before the major races. Up above the ancient city, Su Yu’s hands were trembling lightly. He was trembling in fear. That was way too scary.

If the battle had continued…he would have no trump card to offer. One Daofuse would be enough to end him. Sure, he could flee to the Death Realm. But who could stop a Daofuse for him in the Death Realm?
As for Old Zhou, Su Yu doubted that Old Zhou could even leave the mansion. The mansion wasn’t so useless that its prisoner could leave so easily.
“That was terrifying!”
Despite his thoughts, Su Yu maintained a look of complete indifference as he floated above the city.
